name: Universe Entertainment and Culture Group Company Limited
summary: Universe Entertainment and Culture Group Company Limited is an investment holding company in video and film distribution and exhibition, and in licensing film rights and television series. It also has businesses in financial printing, securities investment, investment property leasing, artist management, a model agency, and wholesale and retail of optical products and watches, operating in Hong Kong, China and the rest of Asia. It was formerly Universe International Financial Holdings Limited until October 2018.
